jordan-cs: FYI customer AcmeCorp seeing intermittent INVALID_JSON errors when calling /v1/generate with response_format=structured_json and strict=true. They also saw a billing spike around the same time. Example curl and response below. jordan-cs: ```bash curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxxxxx" \ -H "Accept: application/json" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"...","response_format":"structured_json","strict":true}' ``` jordan-cs: Response (truncated): jordan-cs: ```json HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 ...
{"choices":[{"text":"{\"user\": \"Alice\", \"age\": 30"} ...
... ``` jordan-cs: So the body is HTML-wrapped but contains partial JSON (missing closing braces) — parser in client fails and they retried which drove tokens. maria-eng: are they on Dedicated or Hosted? acme-support: hosted via EU region. saw latency spike ~14:23 UTC, then 500ms -> 2.3s and client retried 3x. tim-ops: can you paste request_id from logs? acme-support: request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e maria-eng: looking at logs — upstream model server returned chunked HTML error page when auth header short-circuited due to token rotate race. backend returned 200 with content-type text/html but stream contained JSON chunks from runtime, kvcache flush probably truncated tail. billing-bot: ALERT: unusual token usage spike for tenant acme-corp at 2025-11-12T14:24:00Z jordan-cs: repro steps I used: jordan-cs: 1) set response_format=structured_json & strict=true 2) simulate token rotate by sending request with Authorization header concurrently replaced 3) have a model stream connection drop mid-way jordan-cs: quick curl to repro locally (non-prod): jordan-cs: ```bash # start stream, kill connection after 150ms to mimic kvcache trunc curl -N -X POST http://staging.redwood.local/generate \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SHORTLIVED:-stub}" \ -H "Accept: application/json" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"test-mini","prompt":"x","response_format":"structured_json","strict":true}' & sleep 0.15; pkill -f "curl -N" ``` maria-eng: thanks. hypothesis — when a stream is cut we sometimes send last buffered token as HTML escape wrapper for safety, which breaks strict JSON enforcement. Should be fixed in runtime: ensure content-type headers set to application/json and close stream with valid JSON or 5xx. tim-ops: immediate mitigation — add a proxy rule to enforce content-type application/json when response_format=structured_json; if mismatch, return 502 so strict clients get a clear error and don't retry. acme-support: customer wants root cause & ETA. they're pretty jumpy about the billing hit. maria-eng: plan: - patch runtime to not emit HTML wrappers for truncated streams (PR in progress) - add proxy hard-fail on content-type mismatch (hotfix) - add a billing credit for AcmeCorp for the spike (ops to own) jordan-cs: assigning to @maria-eng for patch, @tim-ops for proxy, @billing-team for credit. I'll keep customer updated. maria-eng: I'll drop a short changelog and PR link when ready. tim-ops: proxy rule deployed to EU staging, will promote to prod after smoke tests (30m) billing-bot: NOTE: created credit ticket BILL-4321 for tenant acme-corp acme-support: thanks — will notify customer and request logs if anything else. :thumbsup: maria-eng: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/432 — fix ensures JSON close emitted on stream abort or returns 502. ETA 3d for full rollout. jordan-cs: marking as escalated — will reopen if customer sees further invalid_jsons.
